notes:
The page continues the preceding question and then states a Conjecture fondamentale with two conditions claimed equivalent: geometric origin of the homomorphism and an anabelian centralizer condition on the indicated restriction. The heading is underlined but its colon is not. The hypothesis has a layered addition V séparé before the still-plural réguliers; the crossed upper séparés remains doubtful and is not regularized from the live singular. U une modèle is revised to variété, Alors to Considérons, and tout hom to raised un hom. Script E is clear in the first three extension-group positions; the fourth remains E|B after the blind audit. All three connecting shafts (B_V-B_U, the f equation, and V-U) are headless. Every live hom abbreviation and the crossed hom are dotless, as is inserted ext; isom also lacks the stop H supplied. The marginal note begins underlined NB pr l’instant, concerns V itself as an elementary anabelian model, and ends with clear disons followed by an uncertain dim. 1. group. Its compressed bornera surtout / ramènera phrase remains marked, and the final dim. 1. / donc group remains unresolved. The literal terms anabélienne/anabélien are kept. The long homomorphisme remains first with local doubt under the retracing; H’s shorter morphisme does not account for the initial groups. There is no exclamation mark after déterminé. The universal-looking sign in b has both a V-like crossed course and an A-like returning outline, so ∀ is first with A retained as a graphical alternative; it is not expanded to tout. The small raised rings on the E_V terms are retained as C’s circles; H’s typographic o is not treated as a distinct readable glyph change. Retracing in homomorphisme and the final script E does not reveal a separate earlier word or symbol, so none is invented. No author page number is visible. Thin foliation 47 stays in the margin. The source has running text, inline equations, underlining, cancellations, and insertion leaders, but no drawing or diagram. No mathematical verification was performed. The original-coordinate audit boxes cover all additions, cancellations, the whole marginal note and uncertain dimension numeral, complete doubtful b paragraph, all π_1 indices and final 1, foliation, and different-word disputes.

[Blind audit] All nine differing boxes and the rotated margin crop were reread. The old modèle gains local uncertainty. The topos/types distinction and étales/étale ending remain locally doubtful. The ordinary formula and compatibility equation agree apart from font, braces and punctuation placement in math mode. The margin still supports pr (not expanded), l’instant with a final t rather than l’énoncé, an actual short hyphen after lui, and two bars without m arches for =. Its two difficult word groups remain explicitly open. Condition a has donc, not alors: the tall loop is its initial d, with no subsequent l. The short word before f is recorded as pr|par, without supplying an a or an independently raised r. In the complete centralizer condition the first script E is clear, the second gains E/B doubt, and both small hollow superscript rings remain circles under the local convention; no numerical-zero claim is inferred. The ∀/A alternative and final unit 1 remain. No mathematical verification was performed.
